# The budget of internal RAM for this project, both variants, read by
# tools/check_ram.sh:
#
#   ../../tools/check_ram.sh build/kode_target.elf ram_budget.txt
#
# This project links every component of the SDK with every option on, so
# what it takes of the ESP32-P4's 640 KB of internal RAM at link time is what
# the SDK costs an app before the app adds a line of its own.
#
# static_max is the ceiling of that static image - code in IRAM, .data and
# .bss. It sits a few kilobytes above what the full variant takes, on
# purpose: a change that needs more either moves something to PSRAM or raises
# this number in the same commit, where a reviewer sees it.
static_max 360000

# Every data symbol of 2048 bytes or more in internal RAM, with the source
# file that defines it and the most it may be. A static this size that is not
# listed fails the check: a buffer belongs in PSRAM (khal_alloc_psram()), and
# the ones below are here because something forces them to be internal.
#
# symbol               source file          max bytes

# The stacks of the Active Objects (kqp_config.h's tiers). Internal because
# an AO may write flash, which takes PSRAM out of reach while the write lasts.
console_stack          kode.c               8192
appmgr_stack           kode.c               8192
storage_stack          kode.c               6144
radio_stack            kode.c               6144
nfc_stack              kode.c               6144
display_stack          kode.c               6144
touch_stack            kode.c               4096
power_stack            kode.c               4096
net_stack              kode.c               4096
log_stack              kode.c               4096
ioexp_stack            kode.c               4096
imu_stack              kode.c               4096
boot_stack             kode.c               4096
autotest_stack         kode.c               4096
rfid_stack             kode.c               3072
ledmgr_stack           kode.c               3072
ir_stack               kode.c               3072
haptic_stack           kode.c               3072
buttons_stack          kode.c               3072
audio_stack            kode.c               3072

# QP/C's three event pools.
s_jumbo_pool           kqp.c                16560
s_medium_pool          kqp.c                16128
s_large_pool           kqp.c                16128

# The console's Active Object. It grows with the verbs, so the line leaves
# room.
l_console              console_ao.c         4096

# The SDK's own buffers and tables.
s_mirror_ring_store    kdrv_ble.c           8192
s_ring_store           kdrv_ble.c           2048
s_wifi                 kdrv_wifi.c          4608
s_recv_buf             appmgr_ao.c          4096
s_adopt_buf            appmgr_ao.c          4096
s_fs_buf               kode.c               4096
s_blob                 kapp_cat.c           2560
s_rows                 kapp_cat.c           2560

# What the libraries declare. Listed so that a version bump that grows one
# of them is seen.
lv_global              lv_init.c            17408
xIsrStack              port.c               4192
s_retention            sleep_retention.c    2816
gNfcDev                rfal_nfc.c           2560
